title: Trust the precondition
prompt: Implement `double median(int[] arr)` for a SORTED array (length >= 1 promised): odd length → middle element; even length → average of the two middle elements. The precondition means you may NOT need an empty check — but you DO need the parity case split.

tests.name: median cases
tests.hint: mid = arr.length / 2; odd → arr[mid]; even → (arr[mid-1] + arr[mid]) / 2.0
